mapper.sql: select o.id, o.order_no, o.apply_id, o.quote_id, o.customer_id, o.engineer_id, c.unit_name as customer_name, u.nickname as engineer_name, a.repair_no as apply_no, a.report_address, q.quote_no as quote_no, o.status, o.accept_time, o.start_time, o.finish_time, o.address, o.sign_in_longitude, o.sign_in_latitude, o.sign_in_address, o.sign_out_longitude, o.sign_out_latitude, o.sign_out_address, IFNULL(a.photos, o.photos) as photos, o.create_by, o.create_user, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, o.del_flag, o.tenant_id, o.dept_id from eoms_repair_order o left join psi_unit c on o.customer_id = c.id and c.deleted = 0 left join sys_user u on o.engineer_id = u.id left join eoms_repair_apply a on o.apply_id = a.id left join eoms_quote q on o.quote_id = q.id
mapper.select: select u.id as id, u.nickname as nickName from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id where u.deleted = 0 and u.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0 and r.code = 'eoms_engineer' order by u.id

select count(*) from sys_user u where u.id=#{engineerId} and u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and u.deleted=0 and u.status=1 and exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.id and r.deleted=0 and r.code='eoms_engineer')
mapper.insert:
insert into eoms_repair_order
order_no, apply_id, quote_id, customer_id, engineer_id, status, accept_time, start_time, finish_time, address, photos, sign_in_longitude, sign_in_latitude, sign_in_address, sign_out_longitude, sign_out_latitude, sign_out_address, create_by, create_user, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, del_flag, tenant_id, dept_id,
#{orderNo}, #{applyId}, #{quoteId}, #{customerId}, #{engineerId}, #{status}, #{acceptTime}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime}, #{address}, #{photos}, #{signInLongitude}, #{signInLatitude}, #{signInAddress}, #{signOutLongitude}, #{signOutLatitude}, #{signOutAddress}, #{createBy}, #{createUser}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, #{delFlag,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{tenantId}, #{deptId},
mapper.update: update eoms_repair_order set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id}

update eoms_repair_order set del_flag = '2' where id in
#{id}
update eoms_repair_order set apply_id = NULL, update_time = sysdate() where apply_id = #{applyId}

update eoms_repair_order
status = #{newStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), finish_time = #{finishTime}, remark = #{remark},
where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select * from eoms_repair_order where id=#{id} and del_flag='0' for update
select count(*) from eoms_repair_order where apply_id=#{applyId} and del_flag='0'
select s.* from eoms_repair_settlement s join eoms_repair_order o on o.id=s.repair_order_id where o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.id=#{orderId} and o.del_flag='0' and s.del_flag='0' order by s.id
select r.* from eoms_receivable r join eoms_repair_order o on o.id=r.repair_order_id where o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.id=#{orderId} and o.del_flag='0' and r.del_flag='0' for update

select count(*) from eoms_payment p join eoms_receivable r on r.id=p.receivable_id join eoms_repair_order o on o.id=r.repair_order_id where o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.id=#{orderId} and o.del_flag='0' and p.del_flag='0' and (p.status is null or p.status != 'REVERSED')
select coalesce(sum(i.amount),0) from eoms_income i join eoms_repair_order o on o.id=i.repair_order_id where o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.id=#{orderId} and o.del_flag='0' and i.del_flag='0'
select coalesce(sum(c.amount),0) from eoms_cost c join eoms_repair_order o on o.id=c.repair_order_id where o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.id=#{orderId} and o.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0'
select count(*) from eoms_finance_event e join eoms_repair_order o on o.id=e.aggregate_id where o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.id=#{orderId} and e.aggregate_type='ORDER' and e.action='CANCEL_CLOSE'
mapper.update: update eoms_repair_order set status='CLOSED',remark=#{remark},update_by=#{operator},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{orderId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and del_flag='0' and status='WAIT_SETTLEMENT'
